name: .358 Cal-259gr Stone Hammer®
note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This .358 cal bullet has a 2.5mm hollow point putting it in the Stone Hammer™ class of bullets. 2.5mm is a bit smaller than the typical 3mm usually found in the Stone Hammer™s of this caliber, making this Stone Hammer™ a bit sleeker than others. This bullet will have the expected rapid expansion and deep penetration expected from the Stone Hammer™ line of bullets."
